update.title: Updates
update.up_to_date: Borasuki {current} is up to date for this release channel.
update.error: Could not check for updates. Installed version: {current}. Check your connection and try again.
update.privacy: Checks GitHub on startup. No videos, history or diagnostics are sent. Nothing is downloaded or installed automatically.
ui.temp_protected: An operation/file is in use, or no recognized files can be safely cleaned. Refresh storage after operations finish.
storage.orphan: Old job files with no Queue/History record
storage.partial: Partial file in the job's output folder
confirm.cleanup_extra: Permanently delete verified temporary files in {name}? Engine cache can be rebuilt; the next job may start more slowly. Sources and completed outputs are kept. Unrecognized files are not deleted.
error.temp_busy: Shared temporary files cannot be cleaned during a render, preview, analysis, batch preparation or job edit. Refresh the storage list after it finishes.
error.temp_partial_first: This job has a partial file in its output folder. Clean the listed partial first, then clean the job folder so ownership evidence is not lost.
error.temp_owner: The partial file could not be verified as belonging to this job, so it was not deleted. It may be damaged or belong to another app. Review it in the output folder.
error.package_source: The package address is not an approved source. Setup has stopped; the app's package list needs updating.
error.package_manifest: Package version, size or verification information is invalid. Setup cannot continue until the app's package list is corrected.
error.package_path: The download cache contains a linked file or folder that cannot be written safely. The operation stopped to protect your files; use a regular local installation folder.
error.package_busy: Another process is downloading this package. Wait for it to finish, then retry.
error.package_timeout: The package download reached its time limit. Partial data was kept; check your connection and retry to continue.
error.package_response: The download server returned unexpected file information. Nothing was installed. Retry; if it persists, share the technical details.
error.package_http: The download server rejected the request. Nothing was installed. Check internet access; if it persists, share the HTTP code in technical details.
error.package_network: A secure connection to the package server could not be established. Check your internet connection, proxy and system clock, then retry. Do not disable security verification.
error.package_incomplete: The connection ended before the package was complete. Partial data was kept; retry can continue from there.
error.package_integrity: The downloaded package failed verification and was not installed. The rejected copy was kept separately; retry to download it again.
error.package_archive: A verified package could not be unpacked safely. Processing remains unavailable; retry setup or share the technical details.
ui.batch_scope: Processing settings are shared; color is analyzed for each video.
ui.batch_direct_hint: Open a video from the list to preview it. Folder selection includes only videos at the top level, not subfolders. The list holds up to 200 videos and is not saved when the app closes. Files requiring unprepared processing settings show their own failure reason. Existing files are never overwritten.
ui.batch_queue: Add all directly to Queue with current settings
ui.batch_import_issues: Some files could not be selected. See the reasons below.
confirm.batch_cancel: Stop preparing the remaining videos? Jobs already added to Queue will not be removed or cancelled; manage those in Queue.
batch.preparing: Preparing for Queue; this is not rendering.
batch.stopping: Waiting for preparation to stop safely.
batch.complete: Batch preparation finished. See file results below and added jobs in Queue.
batch.not_added: Preparation stopped; not added to Queue
error.batch_selection: Select 1–200 videos and try again. An empty or invalid selection cannot be processed.
error.batch_format: This file is not a supported video. Select MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WebM or M4V.
error.batch_limit: The selection is too large. Add up to 200 videos in smaller groups; select files directly in very large folders.
error.batch_busy: Another batch is being prepared. Wait for it to finish or stop it first.
error.batch_stale: This batch is no longer current. Check the current batch status.
error.batch_empty: No supported videos were found in this folder. Choose another folder or video; subfolders are not scanned.
adaptive.normal_hint: Subtle contrast and saturation balance. Automatic brightness stays neutral.
adaptive.dark_hint: Darkens the image; this is not a shadow-recovery setting. Changes are reduced if sampled shadows or highlights would lose detail.
adaptive.high_saturation_hint: More vivid colors, with less enhancement when colors are already saturated. Results depend on the video.
ui.adaptive_profile_change: Changing profile resets manual color overrides. You can adjust individual values again afterwards. Preview and final use the same video-wide values.
error.model_integrity: A required model is damaged or is not the supported version. Processing is blocked to avoid an invalid result. The details identify the model; keep them with a diagnostics package for repair. Retrying the unchanged model will not fix it.
ui.preset_scope: Saves upscale, denoise and color settings only. Paths and GPU stay unchanged. Adaptive analyzes each new video; only manual color overrides are reused.
confirm.preset_delete: Delete “{name}”? Existing jobs and their settings will not change.
error.preset_name: Enter a preset name of 1–80 characters without control characters.
error.preset_duplicate: A preset with this name already exists. Use another name; the existing preset was not overwritten.
error.preset_changed: The selected preset was deleted or no longer matches these settings. Choose and apply it again, or change a processing control to continue without the preset.
app.name: Borasuki
ui.active_job_lock: Edit and Preview are unavailable while this job is running or stopping.
ui.source_playback_help: Your current position becomes the preview start. Choose 1, 3 or 5 seconds, then generate the preview. Final output uses the full video.
ui.preview_hint: Check a short sample before adding the full video to Queue.
ui.compare_controls: Drag the divider to compare the original and enhanced image. Use the wheel or + / − to zoom; drag the image when zoomed. Left/right moves one frame; Shift + arrow jumps by the selected interval. Alt + arrow pans, 0 fits the view, Space plays/pauses. With the divider focused, arrows adjust the split. Timeline navigation never starts GPU processing.
ui.preview_display_note: The sample uses the final processing settings. Display copies use H.264 without audio; final output keeps the selected encoding and audio handling.
ui.color_help:
{@color.reference}: applies the fixed reference color settings.
{@color.adaptive}: analyzes samples to calculate one color adjustment for the video.
{@color.original}: leaves colors unchanged.
{@color.custom}: lets you adjust contrast, brightness and saturation manually. Color is independent of upscale and denoise.
preview.empty: Select the start time and length above, then choose {@ui.generate_preview}. If no video is selected, first add one in {@nav.add}.
ui.preflight_checking: Checking disk space, output and required components…
ui.preflight_ready: Check passed. Disk requirements are estimates; checks run again before processing starts.
preview.waiting: Waiting for the current job to release the GPU. It will not be paused automatically.
preview.preparing: Checking the source, colors and runtime…
preview.rendering: Rendering and verifying the short sample…
preview.ready: Preview ready. Queue will use this exact processing configuration.
preview.cancelled: Preview cancelled. Return to options to prepare another sample.
preview.failed: Preview failed. Return to options, check the error and try again.
error.preview_range: Choose a valid start time and a preview length up to 5 seconds within the video.
error.preview_busy: A preview is still preparing or stopping. Wait for it to finish, or cancel it first.
error.preview_stale: This preview is no longer current. Prepare a new preview before adding it to Queue.
error.preview_size: This preview is too large to display. Choose a shorter sample.
error.preview_decode: The sample could not be displayed. Prepare another preview and check WebView2 if it happens again.
error.source_playback: The video could not load. Select it again if it was moved; otherwise use Retry to reopen the player.
error.source_codec: The built-in player cannot open this video format. Select an H.264 MP4 copy. Your source file was not changed.
stage.engine_building: Preparing TensorRT engine for first use
error.invalid_output: Choose a valid output folder and .mkv or .mp4 filename.
error.mp4_tracks: This source has an audio track that cannot be safely copied to MP4. Choose MKV to preserve its audio.
error.mp4_confirm_required: MP4 output will omit subtitles and attachments. Confirm the output warning or choose MKV.
ui.notifications: Show a Windows notification on completion
ui.context_menu: Add Borasuki to the Windows context menu
ui.context_note: On Windows 11, the entry may appear under “Show more options”. Uses the classic menu.
notification.completed.title: Upscaling complete
error.unsupported_gpu: A compatible NVIDIA GPU is required.
error.runtime_missing: Processing runtime is unavailable. See the runtime status.
error.output_exists: The output file already exists. Choose another name.
app.subtitle: Anime upscaling · NVIDIA · 2×
error.drop_path: The dropped file's location could not be read. Use {@ui.browse} to add it. If the app is running as administrator, close it and reopen it normally.
ui.adaptive_note: Adaptive Enhance analyzes distributed video samples to choose one color grade. It does not change upscale or denoise. Analysis currently runs before queueing.
ui.reference_note: 2× Real-CUGAN · TensorRT FP16 · HEVC 10-bit. MKV preserves audio, subtitle and attachment tracks; MP4 omits subtitles and attachments after confirmation.
ui.mp4_tracks_warning: Subtitles and attachments will not be included in MP4 output. The source video is unchanged.
confirm.mp4_tracks: MP4 output will omit subtitles and attachments. Audio is preserved and the source file is unchanged. Continue?
confirm.mp4_batch: Batch MP4 outputs will omit subtitles and attachments. Sources stay unchanged. Files with incompatible audio tracks will fail individually with a reason. Continue?
ui.temp_scope: Shows job and old Preview folders, engine cache and known partial outputs. Only recognized engine cache files are cleaned; they may be rebuilt later. Sources and files with unverified ownership are kept. Active/waiting jobs and ready Preview files cannot be cleaned; wait for operations to finish before shared cleanup. Setup downloads and abandoned analysis folders left after a crash are excluded.
ui.temp_cleaned: Temporary job data was cleaned. Reprocessing starts from the beginning.
confirm.cleanup_temp: Permanently delete all temporary revision folders for “{name}”? A paused job cannot resume; a failed job restarts from the beginning on Retry. The History record, source and completed output remain.
error.storage_scan: Some job folders could not be read safely; the total may be incomplete. These folders cannot be cleaned.
ui.diagnostics_privacy: System information and limited error logs are saved to your chosen folder. Videos/models are excluded and nothing is uploaded. Known private paths and credential fields are filtered; review the contents before sharing.
error.diagnostics_export: The diagnostics package could not be saved. Choose a writable local folder and retry; also check free disk space. Your existing files were not changed.
ui.runtime_existing: Local VapourSynth / TensorRT runtime is available.
ui.assumed_color: Source color metadata is missing. The reference BT.709 color interpretation is being used.
ui.resume_note: Pause stops the current segment. Resume keeps verified segments and repeats only the unfinished one. Closing the app saves queued work.
error.operation: The operation stopped for an unrecognized reason. Retry once; if it happens again, share the technical details below so we can investigate.
error.frame_transfer: Processing stopped while sending video frames to the output encoder. Retry once. If it stops again, share the technical details below; this message alone does not identify a disk or GPU fault.
error.gpu_memory: The GPU ran out of available video memory. Close other GPU-heavy apps and retry. If this continues, share the technical details below.
error.file_access: A file needed for processing could not be accessed. Check that the source and output drives are connected and the folders allow access, then retry.
error.no_video: No readable video stream was found.
error.hdr: HDR / BT.2020 sources are not supported by this first build.
error.interlaced: Interlaced sources are not supported by this first build.
error.vfr: This video's frame timing is not supported. Export it at a constant frame rate (CFR) and add it again; retrying or changing the color mode will not resolve this issue.
error.render_format_changed: This job's checkpoints used the old color range and cannot be combined with new output. Add the same video as a new job. Your source and existing outputs were not changed.
error.timestamp: This video's start timestamp is offset. This build cannot safely preserve audio sync for it. Export a copy with aligned audio/video timestamps, or choose another video. Retrying the unchanged file will not fix this.
error.color: This source's color space is not supported yet.
error.watchdog: The process stopped making progress. You can retry.
error.verify: Output verification failed. The file was not published.
error.source_changed: The source changed after the job was queued. Import it again.
error.runtime_changed: The GPU/runtime changed. Import the source as a new job.
error.invalid_action: This action is not available for this job.
error.output_reserved: Another job is already using this output path.
error.disk_space: Insufficient free space on the output or temporary drive. Free space before retrying.
warning.oom: Low VRAM: retrying with a smaller tile.
ui.add_hint: Choose a video and configure its output.
ui.edit_notice: This job is reserved and cannot start while you edit it.
ui.history_hint: Completed, failed and cancelled jobs. Your videos stay untouched.
ui.settings_hint: Defaults apply to new jobs. Queued jobs keep their saved configuration.
ui.vram_scope: VRAM shows total usage on the selected GPU, including other apps. Unavailable readings show —.
ui.retention_hint: Only paused jobs are subject to automatic cleanup. Deleted resume data cannot be recovered; you must create a new job. Source and output videos are never deleted.
ui.closing: Stopping safely and saving progress. Please wait…
confirm.exit: Exit Borasuki? Active processing will stop safely. Saved jobs and completed checkpoints are kept; unfinished segments may be processed again when the app reopens. Unsaved form changes and previews will be discarded. Source and output videos will not be deleted.
error.app_closing: Borasuki is closing. New operations cannot start. Your saved jobs are kept.
error.shutdown_timeout: Processing has not stopped yet, so the window remains open to protect your progress. Wait a moment, then close the window again. Do not force the app to stop.
ui.analyzing_wait: Checking and analyzing video samples… This may take a moment.
ui.legacy_snapshot: Legacy job: model version was not recorded.
ui.empty_history: No history entries match this filter.
ui.queue_running: Waiting jobs start automatically in order. You can keep adding videos.
ui.queue_held: Waiting jobs are held. An already running job continues until you pause it.
ui.reorder_hint: Drag waiting jobs or use Move up / Move down. Active jobs are locked; paused jobs stay in Queue.
stage.engine_preparing: Preparing processing for the next video
confirm.cancel: Cancel “{name}”? This job moves to History and cannot be resumed or retried. Source and output videos will not be deleted.
confirm.remove: Remove the record for “{name}”? Source, output and temporary files will not be deleted.
confirm.cleanup: Permanently delete temporary resume data for “{name}”? This job will no longer resume. Source and output videos remain.
confirm.clear_queue: Remove all waiting records? Active, paused and editing jobs are kept. No source, output or temporary files are deleted.
confirm.clear_history: Delete all History records? Source, output and temporary files stay on disk. This cannot be undone.
confirm.retention: Enable automatic cleanup 30 days after each pause? Expired resume data is permanently deleted without another popup. Affected jobs cannot resume. Source and output videos stay untouched.
error.job_locked: This job is locked or its state changed. Refresh the Queue and try an available action.
error.queue_changed: The Queue changed. Check the current order and try again.
error.resume_deleted: Resume data was deleted. Create a new job to process this source again.
error.unsafe_cleanup: Cleanup refused: temporary path ownership could not be verified. See logs.
error.source_access: Source cannot be read. Reconnect its drive and check access.
error.output_access: Output folder is not writable. Choose another folder or restore write access.
error.temp_access: Temporary folder is not writable. Check its drive and permissions.
error.form_busy: Wait for the current import or save to finish, then add your video.
error.finish_edit: Finish or discard your current job edit first.
warning.disk_estimate: Free disk space is below the estimate. Actual size varies; free more space before a long render.
ui.denoise_hint: Off uses the engine's no-denoise model; enabled offers levels 1–3. First use of a different level may take longer while TensorRT prepares its engine.
error.denoise_model_missing: The model for this denoise choice is missing. Install the matching CUGAN model or choose an available level; no silent fallback will be used.
ui.analysis_empty: Choose a video to analyze its colors.
ui.analysis_cancelled: Color analysis cancelled. Retry, or choose another color mode.
error.analysis_stale: The color analysis is not ready or is no longer valid. Select Adaptive again and wait for the result.
error.analysis_failed: Automatic color analysis could not finish. Retry once, or choose Custom to set colors yourself. If it happens again, share the technical details below.
ui.setup_gate: Processing is unavailable until the installed runtime passes its compatibility check. Queue and History are preserved.
ui.setup_scope: First-time setup downloads about 3 GB from the official publishers and stores it only on this computer. Available disk space of at least 7 GB is required. Existing app data is preserved.
setup.files: Checking required runtime and model files…
setup.plugins: Loading plugins and checking GPU/CUDA access…
setup.missing: Required components are missing. Install them to enable processing.
error.setup_required: Runtime verification is required. Open Settings, check the installed runtime and wait for the result.
error.setup_busy: Wait for the active render, preview or batch preparation to finish before checking the runtime.
error.setup_failed: The components needed for video processing could not be verified. Run Check again. If it still fails, share the technical details below; processing stays unavailable until this is resolved.
error.setup_encoding: The FFmpeg build cannot encode the required format. Install a build with libx264/libx265 support, then check again.
error.hardware_encoder_driver: The graphics driver cannot start hardware video encoding. Update the NVIDIA driver and run the setup check again. Your source video was not changed.
error.hardware_encoder_missing: The application's video component is missing hardware encoding support. Check the setup components; if the issue remains, share the technical details. Your source video was not changed.
error.hardware_encoder_unsupported: The selected GPU cannot encode this resolution and quality with hardware acceleration. If available, select another NVIDIA GPU for a new job, or share the technical details. Your source video was not changed.
error.video_seek: The video decoder cannot locate frames accurately in this file. Re-export a copy with a valid frame index and timestamps, or choose another video. The unchanged file will fail again; switching to Custom does not fix decoding.
error.analysis_timeout: Color analysis exceeded its time limit while reading the video. Check disk access and try a shorter copy. Retry if the drive was temporarily busy.
error.process_timeout: The operation timed out. Check source disk access and runtime availability, then retry. Technical details identify the process.
ui.discard_edit_first: Discard the edit before changing video
ui.import_failed_source: Could not import: {path}. No video is selected.
ui.linear_decode: Safe sequential decoding is used for this video's frame index; reading later sections may take longer.
error.internal: An error occurred in the application's processing code. Your source video was not changed. Share the technical details; changing settings cannot fix this error.
wait.phase_help: Percentage counts completed frames, samples or checks, not the percentage of total processing time. Counters restart for a new phase. Remaining time needs sufficient measurements. — means no measurement or reliable estimate is available yet.
wait.history_help: This phase estimate uses previous successful preparations with the same GPU, model and settings. Changes in GPU load can affect the estimate.
wait.engine_building: Optimizing the engine for your GPU…
wait.engine_warming: Validating the processing engine with one frame…
preparation.label: Processing preparation
preparation.help: This is not a download or color analysis. The upscale/denoise engine is optimized for the selected GPU and settings. The first build can take several minutes; preparation is then reused. A model, GPU or tile change may require new preparation. Preview/Queue remain unavailable until this finishes. — in Progress/Remaining means no reliable measurement is available yet.
preparation.waiting_gpu: Waiting for the active GPU operation…
preparation.cancelled: Processing preparation cancelled. Retry to continue.
preparation.failed: Could not prepare the processing engine. Review the details and retry.
error.engine_preparation_required: Processing preparation is incomplete. Preview and Queue are unavailable until it finishes.
error.engine_preparation_failed: Could not prepare the processing engine. Open Details to see the cause. Retry; if it fails again, share the technical details.
